Product advantage

 Our expandable container house have those advantage:

  Rapid Construction: Standardized design and production methods simplify the construction process and quickly meet housing needs.

  Low-carbon and environmental protection: low-carbon preset of houses and factories, and "0" pollution of on-site construction. At the same time, the container house can be reused through secondary decoration or dismantling combination, which prolongs the service life and avoids the waste of resources.

  High flexibility: Container houses can be combined and transformed according to needs, just like Lego, to adapt to different construction scenarios.

  High strength: Designed with steel structure, it has high strength and durability, which can resist harsh weather conditions and natural disasters, so that it can maintain a long service life in different environments.

  Mobile: Easily move from one place to another, making it ideal for temporary residences, mobile offices, or places that require frequent relocation.

Common Size

  20ft and 40ft expandable container house are our common size, this size of expandable container house interior layout is 2 bedrooms 1 bathroom 1 kitchen and 1 living room. we also support client according to their needs design. 

  30ft expandable container house layout design like 40ft. if you are interested in 10ft expandable container house their can choice 1 bedroom 1 bathroom and 1 small kitchen design or 2 bedrooms 1 bathroom design.

  small 20ft 30ft 40ft expandable container house only can add bedroom because when house fold the middle don't have any space to put bathroom or kitchen.

40 Feet Expandable container houses offer versatile applications:

Residential housing: NEW BRAND 40 feet Expandable container houses provide cost-effective and customizable living spaces, making them ideal for those seeking compact yet comfortable houses.

Vacation homes: They are perfect as hotel, vacation cabins or weekend retreats, offering a cozy and portable getaway option.

Secondary dwellings: They serve well as additional living spaces on existing constructions, such as granny flats or guest houses.

Construction site accommodations: Expandable prefabricate container homes are well-suited for short-term housing solutions, such as construction workers or event staff.

Emergency housing: Their quick deployment and mobility make them suitable for providing shelter in emergency situations or disaster-stricken areas.

Farmhouses: Folding prefabricat container homes offer practical and durable housing solutions for agricultural settings.
